Application Requirements
Welcome! Below you’ll find everything you need to prepare your materials for admission to the Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering (MAE) at The Ohio State University. Please read carefully and follow the guidelines for your program.
Spring 2027 MS Application Requirements
The department will accept applications for our MS programs for the spring semester. The spring cycle is geared toward experiential students. For thesis students, we recommend applying for autumn semesters.
Learn more about the skills developed, program requirements, and career outcomes for the MS Experiential-Track (Non-Thesis) path and our application requirements.
Autumn 2027 Research Application Requirements
Applicants interested in our PhD or MS-Thesis program should complete the research application requirements.
Learn more about the skills developed, program requirements, and career outcomes for those programs:
MS Research-Track Program (Thesis)
PhD Program
Autumn 2027 Experiential Application Requirements
Applicants interested in our experiential MS program should complete the experiential application requirements.
Learn more about the skills developed, program requirements, and career outcomes for the MS Experiential-Track (Non-Thesis) path.
